  • ` $p.TableOfContents)) 1) }}

    {{ partial "sidebar.html" $p }}
    {{- with $p.Parent }}{{ if not .IsHome }}

    {{ .LinkTitle }}

    {{- end }}{{ end }}

    {{ $p.Title }}

    {{- with $p.Description }}

    {{ . }}

    {{ end }}
    {{ .body }}
    {{- partial "page-meta.html" $p }} {{- partial "pager.html" $p }}
    {{- if $toc }}

    {{- end }}
